module: "Part Text View" window of the Static Editor. It displays the JBeam file of the selected part as a sequence of colored syntax tree (AST, json-ast library) nodes (strings, comments, lists, objects), with line numbers and automatic scrolling to nodes selected elsewhere in the editor. Double-clicking a string, number or boolean node edits it ("Edit Node" modal window). The menu offers Reload, Save, Close and Delete.
notes: Save writes vEditor.astFilename with jsonAST.stringify(vEditor.ast.ast): the source JBeam file is rewritten directly on disk.
Delete calls FS:removeFile(jbeamFilename): it deletes the part's JBeam file (without confirmation).
Bug: the Delete entry runs "ast = nil" (global variable) instead of vEditor.ast = nil; the displayed AST is therefore not invalidated.
Bug: the bool case of the edit window uses the variable nodeEditBoolInput, which is never defined; in practice _editNode directly toggles a boolean and does not reopen the modal for this type.
Rendering uses ImGuiListClipper to draw only the visible rows; on the first render (initTextView) all rows are iterated to compute the maximum width.
The part is read with jbeamIO.getPart(ioCtx, partName) under pcall; on failure the window stays empty.
Data read from vEditor: ast.ast.nodes, ast.transient.linesIndexes, hierarchy, nodeIdxToLineNum, selectedASTNodeMap, scrollToNode, selectedPart, vehData.ioCtx.

menuEntry.desc: Apps menu entry text: "Part Text View".

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: loads the selected part, draws the menu bar, the file info (creation and modification dates), the AST node table and the edit modal window. No effect without a vehicle or selected part.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Editor hook called at initialization: registers the window (500x400, vehicleEditor tool) and the "editASTNode" modal window.
